objective: Measure the actual pexprb54s4 dependency-level-1 U2/D2 prefix on the first runtime proposal after an R-JF event, without full E continuation or active switching.

frozen_k1_comparator.authority: exact v2.5 frozen budget-filtered decision steps

k3_development_candidate.authority: development-only; selected after N=128/N=512 attempt-causality analysis

k2.reason: two N=512 semilinear events target rejected/failed first next proposals

steps: evaluate f0 at the proposed base state
compute raw and tolerance-scaled early-flow-defect telemetry

resumability.rule: A full pexprb54s4 step resumed from a retained level-1 prefix must reproduce the ordinary full-step numerical outputs, fused-phi reports, telemetry, and total WorkCounters exactly; level-1 work must not be repeated.

runtime_causality.event_time: after an accepted committed R-JF step
runtime_causality.probe_target: the first subsequently proposed R-JF trial (t,y,h_trial), whether that R trial later accepts or rejects

hard_gates: R-JF committed trajectory and all R attempt rows exactly match v2.6
full E continuation count is zero
level-1 report contains exactly the U2 fused action and D2-derived telemetry
resumed full-step exact parity test passes
all prefix work is retained as speculative work
debug wall time is not promotion authority
historical G4-S4 prefix timing is never substituted for the actual U2/D2 prefix
stop_conditions: prefix factoring changes ordinary pexprb54s4 numerical outputs or work counters
R-JF committed or attempt trace drifts
full E level 2/3 work appears in the research campaign
thresholds are retuned from N=512 output
